sourceIdentity.sourceScope: Runtime, schemas, benchmark/package/build configuration, and tests; generated documentation and benchmark artifacts are excluded.
sourceIdentity.identityNormalization: Relative paths use forward slashes and text line endings are normalized to LF before hashing.

methodology.targetDefinition: Every measured owned-browser process-tree RSS sample is at or below the target and every required CDP/JavaScript/DOM/form/screenshot-preflight/teardown check passes.
methodology.memoryDefinition: Aggregate RSS for the complete owned browser process tree; the Node coordinator is disclosed separately and is not hidden in browser RSS.
methodology.renderingControl: Cockroach Browser declares a no-visual-action policy and rejects capture at preflight. This does not assert that the selected engine binary exposes or received a renderer-disable launch switch.
methodology.workload: One runtime-owned loopback CDP server, one non-visual data-URL document, JavaScript evaluation, DOM query, input, and click.

energy.reason: No calibrated platform energy counter is available; CPU time is not watts.
